title: Clock Synchronization activation
purpose: Exercise a timed control ASDU combining command semantics, addresses, activation cause, and CP56Time2a field parsing.
expected_behavior: The peer parses TypeID 103 as a clock synchronization command with activation cause 6 and a seven-byte CP56Time2a value representing 2024-01-01 00:00:00.000.
constraints_preserved: The I-format APCI length 0x14 equals four control bytes plus the 16-byte ASDU.
TypeID 103 is C_CS_NA_1 according to the supplied operation catalog.
VSQ is 1, cause is 6, common address is 1, and IOA is 0.
The final seven bytes are reserved for CP56Time2a and encode zero milliseconds, minute, and hour, day 1, month 1, and year 24.
The frame uses a distinct timed control layout rather than a monitoring or single-command payload.
issue_safety_notes: PK-only valid structural analogue; timestamp and addresses are ordinary values, with no exact historical payload collision or vulnerability assertion.
